description: Property vectors of the base paper [0] and the 16 reviewed works [1]-[16]; hand-extracted from the verified reader reports mv/papers/pNN.md (sections 1-3, 5) and the earlier entries; no simulation.

route.C: learning and prediction under adaptive collection

setting.bayes: Bayesian posterior (adaptive linear Gaussian / exp. family)

works.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34: 7460-7471

notes.setting: history-dependent policy pi_t(A_t|X_t,H_{t-1}); simulations: two-arm and contextual Thompson sampling (p00 §3.4)
notes.inference: self-normalised chi^2 ellipsoid, Theorem 1 (uniform asymptotic normality) (p00 §2 row 17, §3.3)
notes.prop: weights W_t = sqrt(pi_sta/pi_t) need the logged pi_t; C9 bounded ratios (p00 §2 rows 12, 15d)
notes.stab: weights replace stability: conditional variance fixed under pi_sta (p00 §3.2, §5a)
notes.misspec: correct specification: target defined conditionally on (X,A) (p00 §2 row 8); explicit statement NOT re-verified (row 27c); follow-ups target the misspecified case (§3.7)

works.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33: 9818-9829

notes.group: Zhang: Dept. of Computer Science confirmed; "Harvard" for all three only indirect (author copy on Janson's Harvard page) (p01 §1, §2 rows 4-5)
notes.inference: batch-studentised BOLS, t_{n-2} / N(0,1) reference (p01 §2 rows 10, 18)
notes.prop: BOLS does not use the logged pi_t (p01 §3.4)
notes.stab: BOLS needs conditionally i.i.d. actions within a batch and clipping, not Lai-Wei stability (OLS does) (p01 §3.2)
notes.misspec: robust to a non-stationary baseline (abstract, p01 §2 row 17); otherwise a difference of arm means (our reading)

works.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34: 28548-28559

notes.inference: CADR: inverse-sd stabilised one-step estimator, asymptotically normal (p02 §3)
notes.group: Bibaut (first author) at Netflix confirmed; van der Laan (UC Berkeley, last author) from the earlier extraction only (p02 §1, §2 row 4); group from context_routes.md
notes.prop: known logging policy g_t; DR score uses g*/g_t (p02 §3)
notes.stab: does not need asymptotic stabilisation of the logging policy; needs exploration-rate A3/A6 instead (p02 §3 limitations)
notes.misspec: outcome model need only converge to a fixed limit (A4), black-box regressors allowed (p02 §3)

works.venue_full: Journal of the European Economic Association 22(2): 781-836

notes.estimand: stratum x arm means (Theorem 1 item 4) (p03 §2 row 17)
notes.inference: Wald "as if assignment were not adaptive"; also randomisation p-values (exact under the sharp null) and Bayesian credible sets (p03 §2 row 24, §3.4)
notes.prop: unweighted cell means; randomisation inference needs the algorithm, not the propensities (p03 §3.4)
notes.stab: converging shares from a floor gamma/k plus a unique optimum (Assumption 1, Theorem 1 item 2) (p03 §2 rows 15, 18)
notes.misspec: saturated Bernoulli cell means; stationarity assumed (B.8) (p03 §3.6) - our reading

notes.estimand: arm success rates theta^d; goal is the choice of the best arm (policy regret) (p04 §3.1)
notes.inference: posterior means / SDs / p_T^d; no frequentist interval (p04 §2 row 19)
notes.guarantee: T -> infinity with fixed wave size; corrected Theorem 1 (p04 §3.2)
notes.stab: unique best arm assumed; non-random limit shares are a result; link to Wald stability is our inference (p04 §2 row 20)
notes.misspec: binary outcomes, no interference, i.i.d. stationary (p04 §3.1) - our reading
notes.real: PAD agricultural-extension field implementation in India, 17 waves of 600 (p04 §3.4)

works.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38 (pages not verified)

notes.setting: adaptive linear Gaussian: bandits, adaptive regression, LQR (p05 §3.1)
notes.inference: Bernstein-von Mises in TV to the representative normal (p05 §2 rows 8-10)
notes.stab: BvM itself needs no stability; frequentist validity of credible sets needs it (negative result) (p05 §2 rows 9, 14)
notes.misspec: theorems stated for the linear Gaussian / exponential-family model (p05 §3.1); author-stated limitations on misspecification NOT verified (p05 §3.5) - our reading

notes.prop: only Corollary 2 (ATE under adaptive P_t in [p_min, 1-p_min]) uses the known propensities; mean CSs do not (p06 §2 row 14, §3.2)
notes.stab: supermartingale + Ville: no stability or CLT (p06 §5a)
notes.group: affiliations not verified in p06; group from context_routes.md

works.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36 (volume number not explicitly verified)

notes.misspec: "especially suitable for problems with well-specified likelihoods" (abstract) (p07 §2 row 14)
notes.real: GLM bandits, survival analysis, noise families; data sources NOT verified (p07 §3.4)

works.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37

notes.setting: kernelised (dueling / logistic) bandit on an infinite domain (p08 §3.1)
notes.estimand: RKHS utility f (kernel logistic regression function) (p08 §2 row 9)
notes.misspec: Bradley-Terry link, f in RKHS with known norm bound B (p08 §2 rows 9, 14)

works.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35

notes.setting: adaptive experimental design: queries depend on past noise (p09 §3.1)
notes.estimand: linear functional C theta of an RKHS element (p09 §2 row 4)
notes.guarantee: mixture supermartingale (time-uniform route); "for all t" wording NOT verified (p09 §2 row 18)
notes.misspec: fixed, explicitly bounded bias allowed; kernel and V_0 assumed known (p09 §3.1)
notes.real: differential equations, linear bandits, gradient maps, stability verification; data sources NOT verified (p09 §3.4)

works.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34: 19261-19273

notes.inference: excess-risk and regret rates, no intervals (p10 §2 row 16)
notes.prop: importance weights g*/g_t from the known logging policy (p10 §2 rows 10, 19)
notes.misspec: target is the best-in-class risk minimiser under the reference design - our reading of "minimise the average of a loss over a hypothesis class"
notes.real: "an empirical investigation validates our theory"; designs NOT verified (p10 §3)
notes.group: affiliations not verified in p10; group from context_routes.md

notes.estimand: population (pool) risk used for training / evaluation (p11 §3.1)
notes.inference: unbiased point estimators PURE / LURE, no CLT or intervals (p11 §2 rows 13, 16)
notes.guarantee: exact unbiasedness for every M (Theorems 1, 3) (p11 §2 row 9)
notes.prop: acquisition probabilities q must be known and positive (p11 §2 row 15)
notes.misspec: design-based: unbiased for any model (p11 §2 row 9)

works.venue_full: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 119(43): e2204569119

notes.prop: known, randomised design density including its normalising constant (p12 §2 row 12)
notes.real: fluorescent proteins (2^13 sequences) and AAV capsids (p12 §3.2-3.3)

notes.setting: multi-unit sequential experiment with pooled adaptive policies (p13 §2 rows 10-12)
notes.estimand: counterfactual mean of each unit at each time (p13 §2 row 10)
notes.prop: nearest neighbours, no inverse-propensity weighting (p13 §2 row 14)
notes.stab: exploration floor + conditional independence across units; a policy-stability quantity enters the 2022 CLT, final version NOT verified (p13 §2 row 18, §3.3)
notes.misspec: non-parametric latent factor model: no parametric form for f, latent factors or noise (p13 §2 row 15), but the factor structure, i.i.d. time factors and no carry-over are required (p13 §2 rows 15, 26) - our reading

notes.inference: Theorem 4: computable confidence bound under Assumption 3 (filtration-adapted, adaptive data allowed) (p14 §3.3)
notes.stab: Theorem 4 needs only Assumption 3; Theorems 2-3 need i.i.d. episodes (p14 §2 row 14)

notes.inference: episode-level bootstrap; Theorem 4.2 CLT and Theorem 5.1 bootstrap consistency (p15 §3.2)
notes.stab: K independent episodes from one behaviour policy: no adaptivity across episodes (stronger than stability) (p15 §5a) - classification is ours
notes.misspec: theory for linear FQE (p15 §2 row 4); the completeness condition (Condition 4.1) itself NOT verified (p15 §2 row 11) - our reading
notes.real: Cliff Walking, Mountain Car, sepsis simulator (simulators) (p15 §3.4)

notes.inference: Z-estimator CLT (Theorem 6.1) and vanilla / multiplier bootstrap CI (Corollary 7.2) (p16 §2 rows 14-17)
notes.stab: K i.i.d. episodes from a fixed behaviour policy (p16 §2 rows 9, 19) - classification is ours
notes.misspec: without completeness the statistical error of theta-hat is still bounded, the variance formula is not (p16 §3.7)
notes.real: no experiments in the arXiv text (p16 §3.6)
